boulder-control.label: Hill giant: correct path, unfavorable teleport outcome
boulder-control.explanation: The original counts the throwing giant itself as an obstacle and estimates zero danger. Its boulder still removes 18 HP. The helper correction recognizes a clear shot, but the chosen teleport costs 2 mana and still takes 29 HP in this seeded recording. Correct recognition is not uniform safety.
